_notes.releaseNotes: Pages the watcher reads when a new model appears. Claims found are saved as draft scenarios for review.
_notes.predecessors: Optional map of new model ID to the model it replaces, e.g. {"gpt-6-sol": "gpt-5.6-sol"}. Otherwise the closest ID is guessed.
_notes.prices: Optional map of model ID to [input, output] $ per 1M tokens for draft scenarios, e.g. {"gpt-6-sol": [2, 10]}.
_notes.maxCallsPerScenario: Budget guard. Repeats are reduced until a scenario fits under this many API calls.
